# Composio Search

Composio Search provides comprehensive web search across travel (flights, hotels, events), e-commerce (Amazon, Walmart, shopping), financial markets, news, academic research, images, and location services.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/composio-search/.

## Actions

- **Exa Answer** (read-only): Get answers with citations using the exa api.
- **Composio DuckDuckGo Search** (read-only): The duckduckgosearch class utilizes the composio duckduckgo search api to perform searches, focusing on web information and details.
- **Composio Finance Search** (read-only): The financesearch class utilizes the composio finance search api to conduct financial searches, focusing on financial data and stock…
- **Composio Google Events Search** (read-only): The eventsearch class enables scraping of google events search queries.
- **Composio Google Maps Search** (read-only): The googlemapssearch class performs a location-specific search using the composio goolge maps search api.
- **Composio Google Search** (read-only): Perform a google search using the composio google search api.
- **Composio Image Search** (read-only): The imagesearch class performs an image search using the composio image search api, to target image data and information.
- **Composio LLM Search** (read-only): The composio llm search class serves as a gateway to the composio llm search api, allowing users to perform searches across a broad range…
- **Composio News Search** (read-only): The newssearch class performs a news-specific search using the composio news search api.
- **Composio Scholar Search** (read-only): Scholar api allows you to scrape results from a google scholar search query.
- **Composio Shopping Search** (read-only): The shoppingsearch class performs a product search using the composio shopping search api.it specifically target shopping results related…
- **Composio Similarlinks** (read-only): Perform a search to find similar links and retrieve a list of relevant results.
- **Composio Trends Search** (read-only): The trendssearch class performs a trend search using the google trends search api, to target trend data and information.
